name: First Cable Line Inc
old_description: Superior and a leading position in the market as the trusted manufacturer of high-quality cable assemblies.
about:
First Cable Line, Inc. was founded in 1993 in Arcadia, California, where it maintains its headquarters and a stocked facility. The company operates as an electronics manufacturing services (EMS) provider under the leadership of General Manager Michael Lin, with additional production sites in three countries that give it a geographic advantage for global customers.

The company delivers full turnkey manufacturing, ranging from custom cable assemblies and wire harnesses to printed circuit board assembly using surface-mount and through-hole lines, metal stamping, and complete contract manufacturing. Its Arcadia location carries a large inventory of standard data and networking cables, while the offshore facilities extend capacity for higher-volume runs.

First Cable Line serves a broad industrial base that includes telecommunications, military and aerospace, audio and video, automation, cloud data storage, intelligence/surveillance/reconnaissance, consumer electronics, and industrial machinery. Customers range from OEMs in consumer electronics to defense contractors requiring specialized harnesses.

The firm emphasizes a “total quality system” backed by UL, ISO 9001, and QS-9000 certifications, along with RoHS and WEEE compliance. It positions itself as a one-stop shop that can accelerate time to market through rapid quoting, design-for-cost improvements, and on-time delivery.
